food-com-ga-hoi-an.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: travel food discovery card, landscape 3:2. Create one elegant editorial watercolor and gouache illustration, distinctly hand-painted rather than a photograph. Accurate, appetizing finished food fills about 75 percent of the frame. Three-quarter overhead composition, lightly textured warm ivory paper and restrained soft wash background, natural daylight, rich food color, fine brushwork and clear silhouettes that remain readable as a small card. No text, lettering, watermark, logo, collage, split panels or extra unrelated dishes. Subject: Hoi An com ga chicken rice: fluffy separate golden-yellow rice grains cooked in chicken stock on a modest ceramic plate, a mound of pale poached chicken torn into fine strips, fresh Vietnamese coriander leaves and fine onion slices, with a small chili dipping bowl. The chicken skin is tender pale ivory-yellow and the meat delicate and white, not roasted, not fried, no crispy brown drumstick. The rice is plain aromatic yellow chicken rice, not mixed fried rice with carrot and peas.
